'''Resh''' was a [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted]] [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] needed to board the Imperial [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Korriban's Flame]] to search for fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jomar Chul]], the Hero's ally and former [[Emperor's Wrath]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] broadcast Resh's clearance codes. This deceived the station's crew into believing that the group's [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]] belonged to the Grand Moff.<ref name="Fallen" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grand Moff Resh was first mentioned in the Jedi Knight mission "Fallen" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Fallen" />
